answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, like a wharf worn by the tide. A fake farm can flare briefly, but every idle clone's weight thins across the tundra the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever, so a one-time sparrow-swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill.
